title: Cyndi Lauper, Ariana DeBose help New York charity gala raise over $750,000 for nonprofits
summary_full: At the 2026 Fetch Pet Gala in New York City, stars like Cyndi Lauper and Ariana DeBose brought their talents to the stage, raising over $750,000 for four animal rescue nonprofits. This event also featured adoptable dogs gracing a green carpet, enhancing their chances for adoption. SATELLAI, the event's sponsor, contributed by providing devices to new pet adopters, showcasing a powerful community commitment to animal welfare through celebrity support.
